statement: On one exact rational fixed-class reduced Hodge branch, produce for reasons independent of pointwise Hodge algebraicity a bounded/pointed algebraic-cycle family W (for example from a specified correspondence/Lefschetz structure, cycle-moduli construction through z0, normal-function lift to cycles, or degeneration/specialization construction) and prove W→T dominates while preserving the rational coefficient vector and cycle category.
success_contract: family restriction/selection is justified without assuming every α_t is algebraic
exact cycle-class equality is source-bound and coefficient-preserving
properness or another explicit image-closure mechanism is verified
selected-witness versus class-level replacement semantics are frozen
falsifier: Reject a proposal if its family is defined as the union of all witnesses for α, if selection uses the desired algebraicity conclusion, if it only proves detector vanishing, or if it loses coefficient/category/pointed semantics.
candidate_route_families: algebraic correspondences/Lefschetz decomposition with explicit source-cycle generation
pointed Hilbert/Chow incidence through a central witness with deformation theorem
normal functions only when accompanied by an actual cycle-lifting theorem
degeneration/specialization with monodromy and singular-fibre witness control
downstream_residuals: higher-Artin/formal lifting if required by chosen route
